definition: חֹ֫מֶט noun [masculine] a kind of lizard , only in list of unclean creeping animals Lev 11:30 וְהָאֲנָקָה וְהַכֹּחַ וְהַלְּטָאָ֑ה וְהַחֹמֶט וְהַתִּנְשָֽׁמֶת ׃ (Aramaic is chameleon ).

חֹ֫מֶט noun [masculine] a kind of lizard, only in list of unclean creeping animals Lev 11:30 וְהָאֲנָקָה וְהַכֹּחַ וְהַלְּטָאָ֑ה וְהַחֹמֶט וְהַתִּנְשָֽׁמֶת ׃ (Aramaic is chameleon).
